basics.name: Amir Ali Jiwani
basics.label: Engineering Manager / Lead — Platform, Identity & Distributed Systems
basics.summary: Engineering Manager with 12+ years leading platform and identity engineering teams. Experienced in hiring, coaching, setting OKRs, and delivering high-impact platform outcomes across marketplace products. Strong technical background enabling hands-on leadership of migrations, observability improvements and secure authentication platforms at scale.

work.summary: Lead and people/technical manager for SEEK's identity and marketplace platform. Responsible for hiring, coaching, roadmap and cross-team delivery to ensure secure, reliable authentication across product teams.
highlights: Led and grew platform teams (up to 7 direct reports historically; current team ~4); hired 7 engineers via a centralised hiring pipeline and authored a successful promotion case aligned to the Engineering Growth Framework.

Shaped platform roadmap and quarterly OKRs for marketplace identity services used across SEEK; partnered with Product and Architects to prioritise initiatives that delivered measurable business value.
Managed consolidation of SeekPass into Seek identity, delivering a 93% increase in shared user data and removing ~97% duplicate MAUs.
Instituted organisation-wide monitoring and incident practices (auto alerts on AWS ECS, structured telemetry), reducing customer-visible incidents and speeding recovery.
Led cross-team incident responses and postmortems; directed a critical rollback and root-cause analysis that fixed an SDK transpilation bug affecting multiple teams.

work.summary: Reorganized engineering, established hiring pipelines and led cross-product authentication and legacy decommissioning initiatives for PureVPN and related products.
highlights: Reorganized a single 30+ engineering group into ~10 focused squads with EMs and architects, enabling parallel delivery and AAARRR framework execution.
Built a centralised hiring pipeline (resume → coding → collaboration → culture) and hired 10+ engineers and interns, improving hiring throughput and quality.
Introduced team practices (regular 1:1s, career conversations, tech-debt discipline) that improved team health and delivery predictability.
Led cross-product authentication programme and legacy decommissioning that improved platform security posture and operational stability.

work.summary: Senior engineer and team collaborator who helped embed Agile practices, reusable components and cloud-native patterns to modernise ERP client experiences.
highlights: Acted as a senior full-stack engineer in a 6-person cross-functional team; embedded Agile ceremonies and helped the team progress from forming to performing.
Championed reusable components, developer tooling and CI/CD practices that raised team velocity and were adopted elsewhere in the organisation.
Packaged POCs for multiple clients and iterated rapidly to validate business value and inform roadmap decisions.

work.summary: Founded and scaled a cross-platform studio; led hiring, client engagements and product delivery across games, mobile and web.
highlights: Scaled the company from 2 → 30+ engineers, hiring and mentoring cross-functional teams across web, mobile, desktop and games while maintaining low attrition.
Managed client engagements (Mobank, Windows 8 launch apps) and converted client needs into repeatable delivery patterns and reusable platforms.
Led early experimentation with new platforms and tooling (early Docker adoption, remote collaboration tooling) to improve developer productivity and time-to-market.

work.summary: Condensed summary for shorter tenures (PicklesAuctions, Agoda, short engagements). Focused on architecture, team formation and platform initiatives.
highlights: Led architecture and platform initiatives, team formation and migrations across short-term leadership engagements.

meta.notes: Consolidated SEEK roles, years-only dates, Australian conventions (Melbourne, VIC). Manager-first wording and impact-focused bullets. Gaditek tenure adjusted to 2021-2022.
